answer: Assume nobody maintains the graph. Edges decay on their own at 8% a week, so stale vouches fade without an operator pruning them, and one paid slot per identity per epoch caps the damage a forgotten key can do. Quorum has to span unrelated subnetworks, which a lazy operator gets for free because real users sit in different places. A comet of new keys parked in one haven of hosting still counts as one subnet, and a lagoon of reseller boxes reads the same way.
